change_summary: Research-only player prop joint audit classifier: classify common atomic components between two combined statistics as structural overlap; add disjoint-stat positive controls and permutation regression.
assumptions: Known composite stat definitions PR/PA/RA/PRA/PTS_REB_AST and RUSH_REC_YDS are explicit unions of their component stat results.
Shared underlying stat components imply a structural overlap in outcomes, not an independently learned stochastic correlation.
Unrelated stat components remain empirical research candidates; no claim of modeled or profitable correlation follows from class labels.
All tests are synthetic and do not authenticate historical player prop source clocks, identities, prices, grades, or forecasts.
agent_identity: GPT-6 SportsEdge independent combined-stat structural audit lane

baseline.metric: known same-player composite-composite overlapping stats mislabeled empirical
